council_map.vintage: Probably the current map: the four election-district PDFs were created Feb 2 2023 and the at-large PDF (election-district-1-4.pdf) Feb 17 2023, after the 2022 redistricting cycle. Not confirmed by an ordinance. The older precinct-1..4.pdf maps carry a Dec 2020 creation date.
council_map.notes: Per-district map PDFs are linked from each council member's row on the council page (saved: raw/plymouth-in/election-district-1.pdf .. -4.pdf, election-district-1-4.pdf for at-large, precinct-1..4.pdf). Map pages carry the title 'City of Plymouth Election District Divisions'; district 1 PDF titled '1st District - Duane Culp'. These are raster/vector maps with street labels, no precinct list in the text. City code Chapter 31 has an appendix 'Map of Plymouth Councilmanic Districts' per a search result, but codepublishing.com is behind a JS challenge (not saved). No ArcGIS layer found.

notes: Council page: seven members, four by district, three at large. A search result says Marshall County merged Plymouth West precinct into West 1 in late 2021 (not a saved page). No city court on the state directory for Plymouth (Marshall County Superior Courts only).
